metadata.evidence: # NUBes: A Corpus of Negation and Uncertainty in Spanish Clinical Texts
metadata.reason: Identifies the core corpus/project name in the document title.

metadata.value:
The NUBes corpus (from "Negation and Uncertainty annotations in Biomedical texts in Spanish") consists of sentences
obtained from anonymised health records and annotated with negation and uncertainty phenomena.
